t: Robust 10mm hammer tacker is a manual stapling tool designed for efficient fastening tasks. Ideal for trade professionals working on roofing, flooring, or insulation projects, securely attaching materials such as roofing felt, flooring underlay, and breathable membranes. Constructed from durable carbon steel with a polished finish, it ensures longevity and reliable performance. The ergonomic plastic handle provides comfortable operation during extended use. A bottom-loading, open-view magazine allows for quick reloading and easy monitoring of staple levels. Compatible with 6-10mm heavy duty staples from Essentials, Magnusson, and other major brands.
b: 6-10 mm Magnusson & most other brands of heavy duty staple
